description: Run the Xcode project's unit and UI tests on the Simulator. Answers with the counts and each failure as file:line, read from Xcode's result bundle; "0 tests ran" is an error, not a pass. A run past 40 s answers with a job for job_status.

device.description: Name or UDID; default: the one in use

only.description: Tests to run, like DemoTests/SignInTests/testSignIn; commas for several

path.description: Project folder; default: the current folder

xcode.description: Xcode version (27.1), beta or default, as for app_run

name: tests_run
title: Run the tests
